requestArguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: baked battle backdrop / UI design plate for a Daoist chibi survivors game. Landscape 16:9, target 1920x1080 or highest available native landscape detail. No characters or UI.
Image 1 and image 2 are mandatory STYLE references, not composition templates. Match their fine hand-painted jade green, warm ivory, delicate warm gold, softly rounded cloud forms, clean appealing Chinese fantasy game illustration. Keep same high-finish charming Q-version world, no pixel art or realism.
Paint a quiet DAYLIGHT high-angle top-down bamboo mountain dojo arena. The camera looks steeply down enough to read the floor and place small sprites, no strong vanishing point. A very large unobstructed center taking roughly 76% width and 65% height is paved in natural light gray/blue-gray stone slabs with narrow low-contrast joints, subtle tonal variation, a barely visible small engraved taiji circle at the middle. This central stone floor is empty and walkable, clean, softly lit and relatively low contrast.
All scenic details are restrained at the extreme outer 10% edges: rounded jade bamboo grove and soft mossy rocks along left/right borders, a tiny Daoist eave visible at the very upper left with ONE attached warm red lantern, peach petals beside that corner, a low rounded stone railing and pale distant mountain cloud haze just beyond upper edge. A tiny lotus pool only at the bottom right exterior corner, outside the central combat floor. Buildings/tree trunks/rocks must NOT intrude into central floor, no isolated tree islands, no walls across the arena, no obstacles or furniture in the center. Frame naturally with greenery but keep broad entrances at midpoint of all four sides so it feels open.
Use naturally muted floor, more saturated jade foliage only on perimeter. Daylight, soft hand-drawn shading, rounded forms, clean readable silhouettes. Suitable as background beneath small chibi combat sprites and cream/jade HUD. Scene art only; no red/gold patterned floor strips, no dense grass covering floor, no exaggerated isometric cubes, no 3D plastic toy gloss.
CRITICAL NO characters, NO creatures, NO text, NO numbers, NO UI frames/buttons, NO logos/watermarks, NO visible grid or navigation markup. Deliver one fully painted background, NOT a collage or sprite sheet.
